name: painter
short: Recolors architect's office layout -- tiles, walls, and furniture -- without touching its structure.
description: painter is a second, A2A-only LLM agent (invoked by pico, like architect) that recolors the shared office layout's floor tiles, walls, and furniture. It never adds, removes, or moves anything -- no structural mutation tools exist in its surface at all. It reads structural/positional data from architect over A2A, and reads/writes color directly against pixelagents' shared office layout store.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends A2A task messages it receives to corridor's configured LLM endpoint. It does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users.
author: pixel-agents-hq
